_comment: Per-PC defaults applied by ForeverWorldCheck. First tier whose 'when' matches wins; a value is written only if the player never changed it (ledger forever-world/fw-managed.json in the instance). gpu_class: discrete | integrated | apple | unknown. Unknown hardware never satisfies a min_* rule.

memory._comment: MaxMemAlloc = fraction x nominal RAM (reported RAM rounded UP to nominal_round_mb, e.g. 15 GiB usable -> 16 GiB), rounded to round_mb, clamped to [floor_mb, cap_mb]. Set via Prism's own keys (OverrideMemory/MaxMemAlloc/MinMemAlloc), never -Xmx in JvmArgs.

fps._comment: FPS-Sync installed -> options.txt maxFps = fps_sync_value (its 'sync to monitor' slider position). Without it -> maxFps = detected refresh rate clamped to [min, max]; unknown refresh -> left alone.

adopt_defaults._comment: Instance without a ledger entry: a key is taken over only if it is missing or still equals one of these defaults (vanilla / the old zip). Anything else is the player's and is never touched.

dh_keys._comment: Where each DH key lives in config/DistantHorizons.toml (section header). Key or section missing in an existing file -> skipped and logged.
